verdict.rationale: Docs confirm advanced search/filtering by properties (rollbar-gh-2) and an API endpoint that can filter items by level and environment (rollbar-docs-15), plus release/version tracking (rollbar-docs-6, rollbar-docs-7) and person tracking (rollbar-docs-20), suggesting some filterable dimensions. However there's no evidence of a documented query language/syntax, no cross-project search capability, and no explicit mention of filtering by custom tags or properties in a unified query interface. missing for 10: documented query syntax, cross-project search, custom-property/tag filter examples, independent hands-on confirmation.
